verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover the full autonomous lifecycle through the SDK. Agents provision with `Sandbox.create()`, execute with `runCode()` and `commands.run()`, read results via the execution object and `files.read()`/`files.list()`, and tear down with `kill()` or timeouts. Non-interactive API-key auth and LLM tool-use integration are documented for running without a human. One community report notes agents can get stuck looping when they generate interactive terminal commands, a friction point rather than a contradiction of the lifecycle. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that the full create-execute-read-kill loop runs end to end without a human.
